visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame displays a high-contrast shot of a large, black rectangular LEGO retail box resting on a pale, reflective horizontal surface. The packaging art prominently features a three-dimensional render of Mario, characterized by his red cap and blue overalls, driving a red and white kart. The background setting appears to be a brightly lit indoor environment, with intense white light spilling from the top edge of the frame, creating a hazy, overexposed aesthetic. A prominent black rectangular overlay with white Traditional Chinese text is positioned in the lower third of the frame, obscuring the bottom part of the box. (2) The shot transitions into a swift, continuous digital zoom-in that centers on the upper body and face of the Mario figure on the box. As the camera moves closer, the intricate details of the box printing become evident, showing the character's large white-gloved hand in a triumphant pose and his focused facial expression. The lighting remains consistently bright, highlighting the glossy finish of the cardboard packaging. No physical movement occurs other than the camera's digital magnification. The text overlay remains stationary at the bottom of the screen throughout the zoom.
